skill.description: Use inference.sh through the belt CLI to run cloud AI apps for media, search, LLMs, and automation. The skill provides commands for app discovery, execution, authentication, and task tracking.
skill.summary: Run inference.sh cloud AI apps from the belt CLI.

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are Markdown examples or documentation links, not executable skill code. The confirmed risk is installer guidance that pipes a remote script into sh, plus one manual install command that derives a download URL through shell substitution. I found no prompt-injection text or covert data-exfiltration instructions in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Remote script is piped directly to sh in install instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Replace pipe-to-shell commands with a checksum-verified download process and tell users to inspect installer scripts before running them.

remediation.issue: Manual install instructions build a download command from a remote manifest.
remediation.suggestion: Publish explicit release asset links and checksum steps for each supported platform, or require users to inspect the manifest before download.

remediation.issue: The skill documents workflows that upload local files to cloud apps.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit confirmation guidance before any command uses absolute, relative, parent, or home-directory file paths.

content.user_title: Run Cloud AI Apps from the CLI
content.value_statement: Teams need a fast way to discover and run hosted AI apps without managing GPUs. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical belt CLI workflows.
actual_capabilities: Install and authenticate the belt CLI for inference.sh.
Search and browse public apps by category, keyword, and featured status.
Run hosted apps with inline input or saved input files.
Track long-running tasks and save results from task commands.
Use local media paths for supported image, video, audio, and social workflows.
limitations: Requires a working inference.sh account and valid authentication.
Runs only belt commands allowed by the skill environment.
Generated outputs, pricing, and quotas depend on the selected hosted app.
Local file paths may upload files to cloud services when used as inputs.

use_cases.title: Generate Images and Videos
use_cases.description: Create images, videos, avatars, audio, or 3D assets from hosted models without local GPU setup.

use_cases.title: Test LLM and Search Apps
use_cases.description: Call Claude, OpenRouter, Tavily, Exa, and other apps through repeatable CLI commands.

use_cases.title: Automate Production Jobs
use_cases.description: Submit long-running jobs, track task IDs, and save outputs for repeatable production processes.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Hosted App
prompt_templates.prompt: Find inference.sh apps for image generation. Show the strongest options and explain which one fits a simple product render.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Single App
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the belt CLI to run a hosted image app with this prompt: a clean product photo on a white background.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Repeatable Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a sample input file for a Veo video app, explain the fields, then run it after I approve the prompt.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Multi-Step Job
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a workflow that creates an image, turns it into video, tracks task IDs, and saves the final result.

output_examples.input: Find an image generation app for a high quality product render.
output: A short list of matching hosted apps with model strengths.
A recommended app for the stated goal.
The required input fields and expected result type.

output_examples.input: Run a video job and let me check it later.
output_examples.output: The assistant submits the job without waiting, records the task ID, and explains how to retrieve the result.

output_examples.input: Use this local audio file to create an avatar video.
output_examples.output: The assistant confirms the exact local path, explains that the file will upload, and runs the selected app after approval.

best_practices: Review app details and sample input before running paid or long jobs.
Use saved input files for repeatable workflows and easier review.
Confirm local file paths and social actions before submitting them.
anti_patterns: Do not paste real API keys into prompts or shared input files.
Do not run pipe-to-shell installers without inspecting the script source.
Do not upload local files unless the user clearly approved the exact path.

faq.question: What is inference.sh?
faq.answer: It is a hosted platform for running AI apps through APIs and the belt CLI.

faq.question: Does this skill require a GPU?
faq.answer: No. The documented apps run in the cloud, so local GPU hardware is not required.

faq.question: Can it run Claude models?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents OpenRouter and LLM app examples that include Claude model access.

faq.question: Can it upload local files?
faq.answer: Yes. Supported app inputs can upload local media paths to cloud services.

faq.question: Can it post to Twitter or X?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents X app commands, but posting should require explicit user approval.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
